Risa Lombardo

Green candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Arizona · Challenger

Retired paralegal (as described by Politics1.com; not confirmed by an official source)

Risa Lombardo is the Green Party nominee for Arizona governor in 2026. She was a Republican precinct committeeman until days before she filed a statement of interest to run as a Green, and the Arizona Green Party has disavowed her and calls her candidacy a sham. She survived two ballot challenges and won the Green nomination in the July 21, 2026 primary over a write-in candidate the party backed.

Where Lombardo stands

Debates
